bootstrap_success_scope: Bootstrap JSON/private identity and original log retained. Its execute exit/wall receipt is discarded by the runner; later reached source plus passed isolation implies source checks succeeded, but bootstrap exit/time is not a separately retained raw receipt.
resource_invariance_scope: Initial inventory compared directly to exact Git-filtered bytes; final source and copied resource inventories are retained equality booleans, not per-file before/after inventories. No independent native filesystem observation.
cleanup_scope: Raw owned namespace/removal/finalization receipts; no claim of host-wide escaped or short-lived descendant absence.
